text: Line of Beauty: Ger. Schönheitslinie ; Fr. ligne de beauté ; Ital. linea di bellezza . A term applied by Hogarth (1745) to a serpentine line, which he regarded as the most beautiful outline. In his Analysis of Beauty (1753) Hogarth styled the serpentine line 'line of grace' (see GRACE), and restricted the term 'line of beauty' to the waving line ( ~ ). He regarded 'variety' as the ground of its aesthetic value. ( J.H.T. )
